title: Fifth–eighth names: Elohim, Adonai, Schaddai, Heljon
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): FIFTH ELOHIM is (Genesis 1:1 plus in countless places). Sometimes all three persons belonging toward ye Deity it denotes. Ye SIXTH name Adonai is (Daniel 9:17; Psalms everywhere). SEVENTH Schaddai is (Genesis 17:1), ye Almighty. EIGHTH HELJON is (Psalm 9:2 etc.).
pass_b_english: FIFTH is ELOHIM (Genesis 1:1 and in countless places). Sometimes it denotes all three persons of the Deity. The SIXTH name is Adonai (Daniel 9:17; Psalms everywhere). SEVENTH is Schaddai (Genesis 17:1), the Almighty. EIGHTH is HELJON (Psalm 9:2 etc.).
source_text: QUINTUM est ELOHIM, Gen. 1.1 & infinitis locis. Interdum denotat omnes tres personas Deitatis. SEXTUM nomen est Adonai, Dan. 9.17; Psal. passim. SEPTIMUM est Schaddai, Gen. 17.1, ὁ παντοκράτωρ. OCTAVUM est HELJON, Psal. 9.2 &c.
